items.title: Vi Redd interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 13, 1999
items.q: Oh we didn’t mention Mary Lou Williams.

ctx.x: Well I want to thank you for sharing your time with me today.

Oh it’s been a pleasure. I think well, you know there are not too many of us around that were active in the 50s and 60s and 70s, and in sound mind and body. And I consider it a blessing that I’m still here to talk about things that have happened in the past and were very significant in terms of jazz history, and in terms of the roles of women in that. Oh we didn’t mention Mary Lou Williams. © Fillius Jazz Archive -20-
Well how could we — wasn’t she an unbelievable talent?
